scope: source-bound readiness and decomposition only; no production implementation

invariants.name: one_kernel
invariants.application: surface-water capability is a composable optional component around the same SWAP kernel, not a separate SWAP version

invariants.name: kernel_without_io
invariants.application: legacy .dra parsing and calendar tables remain adapter responsibilities outside process/component code

invariants.name: explicit_data_separation
invariants.application: parameters, SWST/WLSTAR physical state, forcing/control, numerical history, scratch and results are separately classified

invariants.name: compact_persistent_state
invariants.application: SWST is authoritative simulated storage; WLS is derived; WLSTAR is conditional control memory; unused options allocate no state

invariants.name: scratch_per_worker
invariants.application: WDIS and WLEVBAL temporaries plus exchange geometry temporaries are trial/worker scratch, not per-column persistent state

invariants.name: scalable_memory_layout
invariants.application: logical component state may be object-oriented while MultiSWAP storage can use optional pools/SoA by model template

invariants.name: transactional_timesteps
invariants.application: SWST, WLSTAR and any reference numerical history must use checkpoint-trial-retry-commit/rollback; rejected trials book no mass

invariants.name: cheap_recompute_warm_start
invariants.application: surface-water trials restart physically from committed state while numerical guesses/history may be reused according to policy

invariants.name: generic_time
invariants.application: legacy day arithmetic is translated into explicit management events; component advances over [t0,t1]

invariants.name: flexible_coupling_windows
invariants.application: surface-water events may subdivide any coupling window without assuming midnight boundaries

invariants.name: coupling_core_functionality
invariants.application: surface-water state is designed from the start for atomic composition with soil-water transactions and interface mass

invariants.name: explicit_groundwater_interface_contract
invariants.application: no new groundwater/MODFLOW contract is embedded; existing coupling head/flux contracts remain external to this component

invariants.name: mass_conservation_absolute
invariants.application: modern balance explicitly exposes q_supply and q_discharge and preserves one authoritative signed drainage/top-surface transfer

invariants.name: interface_sensitivities_first_class
invariants.application: extended exchange sensitivities remain process outputs where qualified; WLEVBAL does not mutate solver Jacobians

invariants.name: limit_coupling_cost
invariants.application: readiness introduces no repeated full-column reruns; state/control composition is intended for predictor/corrector-compatible trials

invariants.name: multiswap_primary
invariants.application: optional compact state and immutable shared parameter tables allow homogeneous surface-water execution classes

invariants.name: no_mandatory_one_to_one_modflow
invariants.application: surface-water component has no knowledge of MODFLOW cell fractions or tile aggregation

invariants.name: deep_vadose_optional_external
invariants.application: no deep-vadose responsibility is added to surface-water or drainage physics

invariants.name: mass_conserving_component_transitions
invariants.application: accepted ledger is authoritative across component transitions and no surface-water storage may disappear on mode/runtime transitions

invariants.name: alternative_soil_water_solvers
invariants.application: surface-water/control consumes clean hydraulic summaries and signed transfers rather than Richards internals

invariants.name: reuse_swap_physics
invariants.application: legacy equations and qualified DIVDRA are reused semantically without retaining MOD_drainage global namespace boundaries

invariants.name: no_headcalc_internal_coupling
invariants.application: automatic control may request GWL, water content/air-volume and selected pressure head through a clean view only

invariants.name: physics_solver_policy_separate
invariants.application: WLSBAK/OSSWLM oscillation handling is classified as numerical policy/history, separate from SWST/WLSTAR physical state

invariants.name: predictable_runtime
invariants.application: legacy WLEVBAL iteration/timestep-reduction behavior is held for bounded-cost numerical-policy qualification rather than hidden inside physics

invariants.name: reference_mode_available
invariants.application: children must retain frozen source semantics as reference while alternative storage/control algorithms can later be qualified

invariants.name: runtime_diagnostics
invariants.application: control branch, availability limiting, supply/discharge, retries and mass closure are first-class diagnostics/results

invariants.name: optional_functionality_scales_with_use
invariants.application: SWST/WLSTAR and surface-water-specific numerical history exist only for active simulated surface-water columns

invariants.name: runtime_coupler_composes_system
invariants.application: runtime orders drainage, DIVDRA, top-surface transfer and surface-water state; kernel component does not know system topology

invariants.name: no_silent_dependencies
invariants.application: readiness explicitly removes .dra, day, midnight and direct MODFLOW assumptions from new contracts

invariants.name: change_audited_against_invariants
invariants.application: this file records the explicit audit before any production child is admitted

required_child_holds: SWSRF=1 extended exchange remains held pending undefined-WL characterization
automatic SWMAN=2 remains held pending clean hydraulic-control view and QHR1/QHR2 asymmetry disposition
no child may hide external supply/discharge behind storage assignment
no child may store WLS independently from authoritative SWST in simulated mode without a separately qualified reason
no child may move WLSBAK numerical history into physical surface-water state
no runtime child may commit surface-water mass or state from a rejected trial
